profile.summary: The Campos Foundation is a private foundation based in Denver, Colorado. Its stated mission is to elevate under-represented minority and female students through STEM (science, technology, engineering and math) education. It runs programs such as summer bridge programs, scholarships, internships and school-based SmartLabs.
